We need to audit StakingVault.sol. It's a simple contract with reentrancy bug: unstake sends ether before updating state. So attacker can re-enter unstake to drain more than they have. The contract tracks stakeOf per address and totalStaked. In unstake, they compute amount = stakeOf[msg.sender]; require >0; then call msg.sender with amount; then require ok; then totalStaked -= amount; stakeOf[msg.sender] = 0;

Reentrancy: attacker can have a fallback that calls unstake again before state cleared, causing amount still same, so they can withdraw repeatedly until contract balance is drained. Howe
